analysis:
Docs-only PR: docs/architecture/prefix-cache.md (full head text reviewed; base diff not supplied, so exact changes are not isolated) and docs/operations/provider-release.md (date bump plus a 0.9.22 candidate paragraph for Bonsai 9B/MTP sidecar). No code, config, endpoint or deployment changes, so no security control changes.

The prefix-cache doc is consistent with T-041: SSD tier default-on, HMAC-keyed lookup tags, authenticated cacheSalt tenant scoping, resident tiers opt-in via DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_MEMORY, DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE=0 as the global kill switch, and authenticated-checkpoint restore with a cold fallback. It states the 'default-on' set for exact model IDs (Qwen, Nemotron, Bonsai 2, gemma-4-26b-qat-4bit, gpt-oss-20b, MiMo), which matches the T-041 per-donation gating description. T-041 still lists only 'CBv2-supported models' generically and the 30-minute TTL; nothing in the visible text raises the TTL or weakens account isolation.

The release doc explicitly disclaims qualification, tagging, registration and deployment, and consistently avoids production claims (aligned with the TB-011 and T-054 posture).

No concrete regression found. The next pass should check any accompanying code changes in the same PR, if any. Nothing in the supplied units shows a code change widening the at-rest surface (SEC-035) or altering the attestation/App Attest authorization flows.
